body: What you seek is seeking you.
author: Rumi

body: The wound is the place where the Light enters you.
author: Rumi

body: You were born with wings. Learn to use them and fly.
author: Rumi

body: The quieter you become, the more you are able to hear.
author: Rumi

body: He who has a why to live can bear almost any how.
author: Friedrich Nietzsche

body: Waste no more time arguing about what a good man should be. Be one.
author: Marcus Aurelius

body: The first and greatest victory is to conquer yourself.
author: Plato

body: We suffer more often in imagination than in reality.
author: Seneca

body: The obstacle is the way.
author: Ryan Holiday, after Marcus Aurelius

body: The cave you fear to enter holds the treasure you seek.
author: Joseph Campbell

body: The world breaks everyone, and afterward, some are strong at the broken places.
author: Ernest Hemingway

body: Man is condemned to be free.
author: Jean-Paul Sartre

body: No one is coming to save you. Build yourself.
author: Nathaniel Branden

body: Become so capable that your absence becomes a problem.
author: Unknown

body: You don't need motivation when you've decided.
author: Unknown

body: Build a life you don't need to escape from.
author: Ryan Holiday

body: The pain of discipline is nothing compared to the pain of regret.
author: Jim Rohn

body: If you are going through hell, keep going.
author: Winston Churchill

body: To live is to suffer, to survive is to find some meaning in the suffering.
author: Gordon W. Allport, paraphrasing Viktor Frankl

body: One day, you'll look back and realize you were building the life you thought you were only surviving.
author: Unknown
